question: For what destructive purpose is the measured object prepared on a copper plate?
premises: A course or extent is likewise measured.
The object is placed on a copper plate.
inference: The measured object is to be prepared on a copper plate for the purpose of destruction.
uncertainties: The exact target of destruction is not specified in this verse.
plain_english: Goddess, likewise, when the course is measured, that is to be done on a copper plate for destruction.
